## Plugin name (suggested)
<!-- A short, descriptive name. The final name and plugin ID can be decided by whoever builds it. -->

## Summary
<!-- One or two sentences describing what the plugin does. -->

## Problem / use case
<!-- What problem does this solve? Who would use it and in what situation? -->

## Proposed behavior
<!-- How should it work from a Zoraxy user's point of view? -->
<!-- Examples: a UI page in the web panel, a request/response filter, a background service, a new routing or authentication feature. -->

## Zoraxy integration points
<!-- Which plugin capabilities would it need? Delete the ones that don't apply. -->
- [ ] Web UI (plugin page in the management panel)
- [ ] HTTP request/response handling (intercept or modify traffic)
- [ ] Static capture / routing hooks
- [ ] Access to Zoraxy configuration or API
- [ ] Standalone background service
- [ ] Not sure

## Existing alternatives
<!-- Any existing plugins, tools, or workarounds? Why aren't they enough? -->

## Additional context
<!-- Mockups, links, references, related issues, etc. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues and plugins and did not find a duplicate
- [ ] I understand this is an idea proposal, and there is no guarantee anyone will build it
- [ ] I am willing to help (testing, feedback, or development): yes / no
